n: MicroFit step counter lesson (Canada Learning Code)
t: A three part lesson where students code a micro:bit step counter and design a strap.
steps: Open the micro:fit Step Counter PDF from Canada Learning Code.
Check that computers can pair with the board.
Gather strap materials such as fabric, tape, cardboard, and elastic.
Open the linked Code.org variables lesson for part one.
Try the step counter program yourself before class.
